event_summary: A small red-and-blue toy kart travels around a blue track with a raised loop and exits the visible area.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with an empty blue toy track on a green cloth surface, with tan wooden blocks placed around and beneath parts of the track. A small toy kart with a red-capped rider enters from the left on the foreground track, moves around the front curve toward the right, travels onto the raised loop section, crosses the upper part of the loop, moves through the inner track section, repeats a visible pass across the raised loop, then returns to the foreground curve and leaves at the left edge.

reasons: The blue track, green surface, backdrop, and wooden blocks are visible.
The moving toy kart is not visible in the first frame.
